registry.description: Testimony is the giving of witness — the public, verbal declaration of what one has seen, experienced, or knows to be true. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers both the formal witness in a legal setting and the personal declaration of what God has done. In the New Testament, testimony is one of the primary modes of gospel proclamation: the witness tells what they have seen and heard. Testimony is personal: it is the one who was there saying this is what happened. It connects inner experience to public truth.
